Sarcasm is saying something, but meaning the opposite — often to highlight absurdity or make a point sharper. Why Context Matters?
Context gives meaning. Without it, facts can mislead and opinions can be misunderstood. At A2D, we tackle complex and sometimes controversial tech, finance, business topics.
